blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Hotlines have been launched by the Philippine National Police on Wednesday for the public to report verifiable information on the whereabouts of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who has been wanted by the International Criminal Court (ICC) since November last year. The launch of the PNP hotlines followed Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s announcement last Friday of a P50-million bounty for the senator’s capture.
